maria.kim: FYI noticed a regression in streaming E2E latency when continuous-batching is enabled on redwood-v2. 95th up ~120ms vs baseline. looks tied to flush cadence + partial-decode scheduling. attaching a short trace.

maria.kim: ```
[2026-02-28 14:03:21] req=abc123 model=redwood-v2 seq_len=16
batch_at_dispatch=8
kernel_choice=matmul_fp16
kv_cache_hit_rate=0.92
partial_decode_delay_ms=80
flush_time_ms=110
queue_wait_ms=35
```

hao: hmm. did we change the short-request queue policy in the last rollout? IIRC the new policy tries to aggregate to reach token_budget before dispatch. :thinking:

devon: we did tweak budget targets. current continuous config uses max_tokens_budget=512 and will hold short requests up to ~30ms to batch. that could push partial-decode past streaming-first-token window.

priya.s: can we make an exception for stream_enabled requests: flush immediately after first token produced or when batch < N? streaming apps expect first-byte fast.

ben: workaround idea: if kv_cache_enabled && seq_len < 32 && stream=true -> bypass batch hold and force flush after kernel completes first-chunk decode. cheap check.

devon: kernel selection might also be amplifying this. profiler shows kernel_choice flips to matmul_fp16 for batched path but matmul_fp16 has slower mem-copy for small seqs vs fused-attn for short sequences. so batching + wrong kernel = worse latency.

maria.kim: good catch. profile snippet from dev box: ```
[profiler] request=abc123 step=decode first_chunk_ms=22 kernel=matmul_fp16 memcpy_ms=45
[profiler] request=def456 step=decode first_chunk_ms=9 kernel=fused_attn memcpy_ms=8
```

hao: sounds like two levers: 1) batch formation/queue policy (short-request priority + token_budget tuning) 2) partial-decode/flush rule for streaming-first-token. Also need kernel-selection rule for small seqs when batch_size small.

priya.s: proposal:
- lower max_tokens_budget from 512 -> 256 for streaming routes
- set partial_decode_threshold_ms = 30 (was 50/80)
- add bypass rule: if stream=true && seq_len<=32 -> immediate-first-flush=true
- add kernel override: prefer fused_attn for seq_len<=64 regardless of batch size

ben: +1. quick AB test flag we can flip per-route. will add runtime flag `stream_first_flush` to rollout.

infra-bot: deploy queued: cont-batch-tweaks v2026.02.28 -> staging at 14:20 UTC (will run smoke + perf-check).

maria.kim: I'll run perf harness against streaming echoes and measure 50/95/99. Devin/ben will add kernel logs and flag. we'll reconvene after staging results. assigned: @devon add kernel logs, @ben add flag, @hao validate queue policy.

hao: also adding a lightweight metric: first_byte_latency_by_seq_len and kernel_choice_tag so we can correlate.

devon: noted. if staging looks good we'll roll to canary with 10% traffic.

maria.kim: thanks everyone. keeping this thread for follow-up results. :thumbsup:
